consent.intro: Before you start using ChatVia, we need to know how you want your data to be processed. This page will help you understand your rights and choices.
consent.intro_note: Please note that this page describes the data processing, which is a preliminary stage to make your data ready for your agent.
consent.how_it_works_intro: When you create a training-based agent, ChatVia will send your data to different providers for processing. Here are the key points about our data processing:
consent.infra_text_after: ), Mistral for EU users, and Google/OpenAI for US users.
consent.storage_text: Your data will be stored and encrypted locally in the EU (Germany/Finland).
consent.no_training_text: We don't train models on your data. Instead, we use RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and GraphRAG to find relevant information and send it to your chosen model for processing.
consent.control_text: You can easily delete your data at any time through your account settings.
consent.region_description: Select where you would like your data to be stored and processed. This choice affects which data protection laws apply to your information.
consent.eu_description: Your data will be stored and processed within the European Union, ensuring full GDPR compliance and maximum privacy protection.
consent.us_description: Your data will be stored and processed in the United States, with strong privacy protections and access to the latest AI infrastructure. This region provides direct access to leading AI providers.
consent.us_feature_1: Access to OpenAI and Google AI
consent.marketing_description: Receive updates about new features, tips, and special offers. You can unsubscribe at any time.
consent.analytics_description: Help us improve ChatVia by allowing anonymous usage analytics and performance monitoring.
consent.gdpr_intro: Regardless of your chosen region, if you are an EU resident, you have the following rights under GDPR:
consent.right_access_text: Request a copy of your personal data
consent.right_erasure_text: Request deletion of your personal data
consent.right_portability_text: Transfer your data to another service
consent.right_object_text: Object to processing of your personal data
consent.important_text: When using AI models from third-party providers (such as OpenAI, Google, or Mistral), your chat interactions may be subject to their respective privacy policies and data processing practices. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies for complete transparency.
consent.contact_text: To exercise these rights or for any privacy-related questions, contact us at
